themes.name: Housing Affordability and Quality
themes.rule: Proposals that increase housing supply or affordability, improve residential buildings, or strengthen renter protections.

themes.name: School and Student Support
themes.rule: Proposals that improve schools, educators, or school-age students' learning, meals, enrichment, and access to school-related services.

themes.name: Public Transit and Cycling
themes.rule: Proposals that improve bus service or rider information, or build infrastructure for safe bicycle travel.

themes.name: Environmental Sustainability
themes.rule: Proposals that reduce pollution or waste, improve resource efficiency, or monitor environmental conditions.

themes.name: Green Spaces and Urban Nature
themes.rule: Proposals that create or enhance parks, gardens, street trees, and other neighborhood green outdoor spaces.

themes.name: Culture and Recreation Access
themes.rule: Proposals that expand public access to arts, libraries, festivals, museums, playgrounds, or recreational amenities.

themes.name: Health and Care Services
themes.rule: Proposals that expand medical, mental-health, screening, emergency-response, specialist, or in-home care services.

themes.name: Digital City Services
themes.rule: Proposals that improve access to municipal services, city information, or public internet through digital tools and assisted service channels.

themes.name: Local Jobs and Business Support
themes.rule: Proposals that support local businesses, workers, employment, licensing, workspaces, or career training.

themes.name: Neighborhood Safety
themes.rule: Proposals that prevent crime or injury through policing, surveillance, street lighting, or safer street crossings.
